seo.title: ADT: AI customer agent (Sierra) across 2 million requests per month (2024)
seo.meta_description: ADT deployed a Sierra AI agent on its help center in late 2024, in a context of 2 million care requests per month.
seo.resume_citable: ADT, a major US home security player, deployed an AI agent built on Sierra in late 2024 to handle troubleshooting and account questions, across a volume of around 2 million care requests per month, with tight guardrails and human review.

faq.q: What does ADT's AI agent handle?
faq.a: Help center questions: equipment troubleshooting, password reset, EasyPay enrollment, with a planned extension toward payment and appointment rescheduling.

faq.q: Why does human review matter here?
faq.a: For a security customer, a wrong intent classification has real consequences, so ADT wires a human escalation whenever there is any doubt.

objectif_business: Absorb a share of the 2 million service requests per month with a reliable AI agent, without degrading quality in a sector where a misclassification has real consequences.
description: ADT, one of the largest US home security players, deployed an AI agent in late 2024 built on the Sierra platform (Bret Taylor's company). The agent handles help center questions: troubleshooting (for example why a panel is beeping), password reset, EasyPay direct debit enrollment. ADT handles around 2 million care requests per month. The capabilities announced as extensions cover payment, appointment rescheduling, and ordering yard signs or batteries. The agent runs with tight guardrails and human review, because a mistake in intent classification for a security customer carries a real cost.
points_cles: AI customer agent on the help center (troubleshooting, password, EasyPay).
Built on the Sierra platform, with guardrails and human escalation.
Context of around 2 million care requests per month.
Evidence level B, live status confirmed.

niveau_preuve.justification: Case study from the Sierra platform (official interested source) cross-checked by trade press that covered the partnership in November 2024; no deviation metric published, hence a B level rather than higher.

fonctionnement_operationnel.cadence: Real time, with dense human review on high-risk intents and regular iterations on the workflows.
fonctionnement_operationnel.opere_par: ADT's customer experience team, co-building with Sierra engineers who embed on the workflows.
fonctionnement_operationnel.signal_pilote: The accuracy of intent classification. For a security customer, confusing an emergency with a billing question carries a real cost, so human escalation is wired at the slightest doubt.

etapes.detail: Map the handleable requests (troubleshooting, password, EasyPay) and set strict limits on what the agent may not do on its own.
Wire the workflows, the connections to the customer account, and the escalation rules on the Sierra platform.
The agent answers troubleshooting and account questions, routing sensitive cases to a human.
Monitor conversations, fix errors, gradually open up new capabilities (payment, appointments).

prerequis_data: read access to account and billing
replication.premiere_etape: Pick the low-risk intents (password, account status) for a pilot, and define the red line of intents to escalate automatically.

playbook.action: Map the support intents, pick a low-risk batch (password, account status), and write the red line of cases to escalate automatically.
Build the agent on the platform: workflows, read connection to the customer account, guardrails.
playbook.livrable: Working agent in a test environment

playbook.action: Open a pilot on a share of the traffic with systematic review of the conversations.
playbook.livrable: Pilot report: resolution rate, intent classification errors

playbook.action: Gradually broaden the scope (payment, appointments) and set up weekly conversation review.
playbook.livrable: Agent in production on the intent batch, volume deviation dashboard

replication.equipe: 1 customer experience lead + 1 integration developer (account and billing API) + support supervisors for conversation review, with support from the vendor's engineers

stack_technique.detail: AI agent platform for customer service on which the ADT agent is built: workflows, guardrails, and escalation rules.
Language models managed by the platform; neither ADT nor Sierra publishes the exact models used.
Component that distinguishes handleable requests (troubleshooting, password, EasyPay) from sensitive cases to route to a human agent.
Access to the customer account (EasyPay, status, billing) to handle transactional requests.

statut_vivant.note: The ADT case is still listed by Sierra as a customer, and Sierra moved to a multi-billion valuation in 2025 with a base of large accounts, which makes abandoning the deployment unlikely in the short term.

transposable_ue.note: Transposable pattern, but home security is a sensitive domain: under the AI Act and GDPR, intent classification (telling an emergency apart from a billing question) must be governed, with a human path and logging. ADT runs it with tight guardrails and human review.
